text.title: Grocery delivery, Moscow, analysis date 1 September 2026
text.entrants: Entry needs 15–20 dark stores (about 60 M RUB) and a courier base; capital is the main barrier
text.suppliers_level: Medium: 3 distributors hold 60% of fresh goods
text.suppliers: About 400 suppliers; switching cost is low for dry goods and high for fresh; supply is 70% of costs
text.rivalry: Price wars in promos; the market grows 25% a year; fixed dark-store costs make exit expensive
text.buyers_level: Strong: buyers switch apps for a 200 RUB promo
text.buyers: Buyers aged 25–45; switching cost is low; 1 in 3 uses two apps
text.substitutes_level: Medium: store chains with their own delivery
text.substitutes: Supermarket delivery and restaurants for quick meals; switching cost is low, price gap about 10%
text.verdict: Attractive for a niche: rivalry limits profit the most
text.dynamics: More chains enter the same districts; courier pay rules may tighten in 2027
text.sources: Market reports 2026, app store data, 6 interviews with couriers and store managers
text.decision: Enter only 3 districts with weekly boxes; defend against rivalry with fixed slots
